name: Painted in lustre over a fired tin glaze and fired again in a reducing kiln

roughness.note: A fired glaze is glossy; the lustre's own metallic sheen, a film of copper and silver particles tens of nanometres across, is not yet drawn.

haziness.note: One specular lobe until a goniometric measurement shows a second.

relief.derivation: no relief is drawn over the work's own image
